svg.title: GBufferC: base color (sRGB-encoded bytes)
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. GBufferC: base color (sRGB-encoded bytes) graph 0001 | BasePassParallel pass | RGB = BaseColor (sRGB target) | no exposure base color: sRGB-encoded RGB bytes no geometry (RGB == 0) Source: DeferredShadingCommon.ush:1012 OutGBufferC.rgb = EncodeBaseColor(BaseColor); EncodeBaseColor returns BaseColor unchanged because the render target is sRGB (:192-196). SubresourceLayouts.json records NativeSRGB=true and ViewSRGB=true for this file; the bytes are the native sRGB encoding and are displayed as-is. No linearization, exposure or tone curve is applied to this figure. The engine's material base colour is recovered by the sRGB EOTF; the manifest stores this statement, not a second image.
